_help: Live data for vassarrowing.com/Give2Brew2026. The donor count and dollars come from Vassar's giving-day site (engage.vassar.edu/portal/giving_day, the Rowing row on the Teams leaderboard), read by the GitHub Action .github/workflows/give2brew-live.yml every 30 minutes before launch and every 5 minutes during the window, and written to give2brew2026-live.json on the live-data branch. Set bot to false to stop that checker; set auto to false to show the manual donors/dollars/updated below instead (after the 2026 close both are off and the final numbers are frozen below). campaign_id is Vassar's Slate campaign id. Videos: upload files to Give2Brew2026/video/ with the names below and they appear on their own at the release time; a Drive or YouTube ID in src is the fallback. featured2, featured3 and featured4 are the wide videos under Why 1,000? (title, by and blurb are editable; remove src/file to hide one). Power 10 clips appear once the donor count reaches their 'at' number. results is the final-results block at the top of the page: set show to true to publish it (preview a draft with ?preview=results). Never put an unrevealed challenge's details in this file: it is public.
updated: Wed Oct 14 at the 1 PM close (final)

results.title: 730 of us. Thank you.
results.lede: For 29 hours on October 13–14, rowers and coxswains from every era, parents, spouses, kids and friends stood up for Vassar Rowing. 730 people gave $63,284: more donors than any other Vassar team, and 80% more than the 405 who gave last year. Along the way, our matchers added $15,000 in challenge gifts.

results.others_title: A record day for every Brewer
others: Congratulations to all 20 Vassar teams. Vassar Athletics set a Day of Giving record: more than $810,000 and 3,500+ gifts from 44 states and 19 countries, and every team beat its donor goal.

Hats off to Men's Lacrosse (428 donors, $162,302) and Baseball (214 donors, $121,201), who led the day in dollars, and to Rugby, Cross Country and Women's Lacrosse for their huge donor turnouts. We'll see you all on the start line next October.

results.thanks: To Coach Wells and our matchers, the cohort captains who worked the phones, the team who gave first and starred in the videos, and each of the 730: thank you. You are ONE OF 1000.
